title: Virtuosity
description: An ex-cop doing prison time chases a virtual-reality killer from the program onto the Los Angeles streets.

title: Scream
description: A psycho killer targets a past victim's daughter (Neve Campbell), while a tabloid TV reporter (Courteney Cox) homes in on his identity.

title: Scream 2
description: A masked killer continues to pursue a California student (Neve Campbell) and her friends at an Ohio college.

title: Scream 3
description: Murders draw a young woman (Neve Campbell), a reporter (Courteney Cox Arquette) and an ex-policeman (David Arquette) to the set of a movie inspired by horrific events that they survived.

title: Hostage
description: A former hostage negotiator (Bruce Willis) must take action when three carjackers hold a wealthy man (Kevin Pollak) and his children at gunpoint.

title: Breakfast at Tiffany's
description: New York playgirl Holly Golightly puzzles a writer who lives in her building.

title: When Harry Met Sally...
description: Harry and Sally have known each other for years, and are very good friends, but they fear sex would ruin the friendship.

title: Serendipity
description: A man (John Cusack) and a woman (Kate Beckinsale) try to find each other after spending one night together 10 years earlier.

title: Planes, Trains and Automobiles
description: An ad exec and a shower-curtain-ring salesman become co-travelers on the way to Thanksgiving in Chicago.

title: Universal Soldier
description: Dead soldiers from the '60s surface in the '90s as high-tech warriors reanimated by the U.S. government.

title: The Guilt Trip
description: Pressured into taking his overbearing mother along for the ride, a man embarks on the road trip of a lifetime.

title: The Firm
description: A law-school grad uncovers a sinister secret about the Tennessee firm that made him an offer he couldn't refuse.

title: Chocolat
description: The mayor opposes a single mother (Juliette Binoche) who is opening a chocolate shop in his 1950s French village across from a church during Lent.

title: V for Vendetta
description: After world war leads to a fascist government, a vigilante known as V (Hugo Weaving) uses terrorist tactics to fight the totalitarian state in which he now lives.

title: Gone Baby Gone
description: Two private investigators (Casey Affleck, Michelle Monaghan) tread dangerous ground as they scour the Boston underworld for a kidnapped child.

title: The Talented Mr. Ripley
description: A young man (Matt Damon) travels to 1950s Italy and begins to assume the identity of a playboy (Jude Law) he was hired to bring back to the United States.

title: John Grisham's The Rainmaker
description: A Memphis law school graduate (Matt Damon) aids a battered wife (Claire Danes) and fights a corporate lawyer (Jon Voight) for insurance benefits for a dying man.

title: The Outsiders
description: In the 1960s Oklahoma a sensitive youth gets in over his head when his best friend kills a member of a rival gang.

title: First Blood
description: Green Beret veteran Rambo (Sylvester Stallone) takes on a Pacific Northwest sheriff (Brian Dennehy) and the National Guard.

title: Risky Business
description: A call-girl helps a Princeton applicant turn his home into a one-night brothel.

title: Failure to Launch
description: The parents of a young man (Matthew McConaughey) who still lives at home hire a beautiful woman (Sarah Jessica Parker) to entice him to finally leave the nest.

title: Scream 4
description: The Ghostface Killer returns with a vengeance when self-help author Sidney Prescott arrives in Woodsboro on the last stop of her book tour.

title: Airplane!
description: A pilot (Robert Hays) afraid to fly follows his stewardess ex-girlfriend (Julie Hagerty) and must take over for the poisoned crew.

title: Bridget Jones's Diary
description: An outrageous British woman (Renée Zellweger) decides to take control of her life, but instead falls for two very different men (Colin Firth, Hugh Grant).

title: Mr. Holmes
description: Long-retired and near the end of his life, Sherlock Holmes (Ian McKellen) grapples with an unreliable memory and must rely on his housekeeper's son as he revisits the still-unsolved case that led to his retirement.

title: Selena
description: A beautiful Mexican-American singer's (Jennifer Lopez) skyrocketing international career ends abruptly.

title: Seabiscuit
description: A jockey (Tobey Maguire), an automobile magnate (Jeff Bridges) and a trainer (Chris Cooper) lead a racehorse to glory during the Great Depression.

title: Scrooge
description: Dickens' London miser Ebenezer Scrooge (Albert Finney) meets the spirits of Christmases past, present and yet to come.

title: Sahara
description: A treasure hunter (Matthew McConaughey) and his sidekick (Steve Zahn) join forces with a doctor (Penélope Cruz) to search for a Confederate ship in Africa.

title: Rock of Ages
description: Songs by Def Leppard, Journey, Joan Jett, Bon Jovi and others underscore a rock 'n' roll romance between a small-town girl (Julianne Hough) and a city boy (Diego Boneta) who meet on the Sunset Strip while chasing their Hollywood dreams.

title: Troy
description: While visiting Spartan King Menelaus, Trojan prince Paris falls for Menelaus' wife, Helen and takes her back to Troy. Menelaus' brother, King Agamemnon uses his brother's fury as a pretext to declare war against Troy.

title: Cold Mountain
description: During the Civil War, a wounded Confederate soldier (Jude Law) abandons his duties to make his way home to his sweetheart (Nicole Kidman).

title: Shakespeare in Love
description: Young William Shakespeare (Joseph Fiennes) falls for Viola (Gwyneth Paltrow), reawakening his creativity, but she is betrothed to Wessex.

title: The Wedding Singer
description: A wedding singer loses all hope when he is abandoned at the altar by his fiancée. He meets a young woman named Julia, who enlists his help to plan her wedding. He falls in love with her and must win her over before she gets married.

title: Uncommon Valor
description: A colonel with a sponsor leads five Marine veterans into Laos to find his son and others missing in action.

title: The Godfather Part II
description: Michael Corleone (Al Pacino) rules his father's criminal empire, while flashbacks recall young Vito's (Robert De Niro) climb to power.

title: Snoopy, Come Home
description: The "Peanuts" gang becomes upset when the beloved beagle decides to leave home in search of his roots.

title: Faster
description: A veteran cop (Billy Bob Thornton) and an assassin (Oliver Jackson-Cohen) track an ex-convict (Dwayne Johnson) who is on a mission to take revenge on his brother's killers.

title: Ghost
description: A slain Manhattan yuppie (Patrick Swayze) reaches out to his lover (Demi Moore), with a medium (Whoopi Goldberg) as his middle woman.

title: Edge of Tomorrow
description: A soldier fighting aliens gets to relive the same day over and over again, the day restarting every time he dies.

title: Flags of Our Fathers
description: Some of the servicemen who raised the U.S. flag on Mount Suribachi during the Battle of Iwo Jima at the end of World War II live to hear of their status as heroes.

title: An Officer and a Gentleman
description: A hardened loner (Richard Gere) shapes up for a military drill instructor (Louis Gossett Jr.) and a factory girl (Debra Winger) from town.

title: Urban Cowboy
description: A Texas farmer (John Travolta) moves to the city, immerses himself in honky-tonk and falls for a sexy cowgirl (Debra Winger).
